title: Well and Hymn
author: Vesper Thackeray
blurb: Coral Ishikawa, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
